blocks.text: Vivah muhurat hota kya hai?

A vivah muhurat is a window of time when the panchang's five limbs — tithi, vaar, nakshatra, yoga and karana — support the union. Hindu tradition holds that a marriage solemnised in such a window begins life with cosmic goodwill. Isliye families wait months for the right date rather than booking any free Sunday.

Muhurat months follow the Sun's transit: most vivah seasons run November–February and April–June, pausing during Kharmas (mid-Dec to mid-Jan in many traditions) and Chaturmas (roughly July–November), jab Dev Uthani Ekadashi tak vivah nahi hote.
Late 2026 — key vivah muhurat dates

items: November 2026: 20 (Uttara Bhadrapada), 21, 25–26 (Rohini)
December 2026: 2–3 (Uttara Phalguni), 3–4 (Hasta), 12 (Uttara Ashadha)
Dates vary by city and tradition — the exact lagna must be fixed against YOUR panchang and kundali.

blocks.text: Yeh dates indicative hain, based on published panchang. Apna exact lagna hamesha apne Pandit Ji se nikalwayein — timing shifts with your city's sunrise and the couple's kundalis.
2027 season at a glance

The Jan–Feb 2027 window opens after Makar Sankranti, with strong muhurats expected through Magha and Phalguna months, followed by the summer window in Vaishakha–Jyeshtha. As soon as panchangs finalise, our muhurat calendar in the booking flow is updated by our Pandit Ji team.

posts.title: Saptapadi: The Seven Vows (Saat Phere) of Hindu Marriage, Explained
posts.metaTitle: Saptapadi Meaning | 7 Vows (Saat Phere) of Hindu Marriage Explained
posts.metaDescription: What do the saat phere really mean? Each of the seven Saptapadi vows explained with Sanskrit mantra, Hindi meaning and why Hindu marriage is legally complete only after the seventh step.
posts.coverAlt: Golden kalash and rose thali prepared for the Saptapadi pheras
posts.author: Pandit Ji At Request — Vivah Desk
posts.intro: Saat phere sirf ek rasam nahi — Saptapadi is THE moment Hindu law and shastra both recognise a marriage as complete. Har phera ek vachan hai. Here is what the couple actually promises each other, step by step.

blocks.text: Why the seventh step matters

In the Vedic vidhi, the couple walks seven steps together around Agni, the eternal witness. The Hindu Marriage Act itself recognises the marriage as solemnised upon the seventh step — कानूनी रूप से भी, saatvan kadam hi vivah ko poorn karta hai.

blocks.devanagari: धर्मे च अर्थे च कामे च नातिचरामि ॥
blocks.transliteration: Dharme cha arthe cha kaame cha naaticharaami.
blocks.meaning: In dharma, in prosperity and in love — I shall never transgress you. This pledge is exchanged during the pheras.

blocks.text: The seven vows, one by one

items: Pehla phera — अन्न (nourishment): we will provide for our home and never let each other want.
Doosra phera — बल (strength): we will be each other's strength in body, mind and spirit.
Teesra phera — धन (prosperity): we will earn and grow righteously, together.
Chautha phera — सुख (happiness): we will share joy and sorrow equally.
Paanchva phera — संतान (family): we will raise virtuous children with love.
Chhatha phera — ऋतु (seasons/health): we will walk through every season of life in health and harmony.
Saatvan phera — सख्य (friendship): above all, we will remain friends for life.

blocks.text: The final vow — sakhya, friendship — is the most beautiful. Vedic marriage does not end at duty; it ends at dosti. जीवन भर के लिए मित्र।
Kya har tradition mein 7 phere hote hain?

Nahi — some communities take four pheras around the fire and count the Saptapadi's seven STEPS separately; Sindhi, Maithil and South Indian vidhis each have their own beautiful sequence. A trained Pandit Ji adapts to your parampara while keeping the essential Vedic rites intact.
Our Pandit Ji narrates every phera's meaning live, so every guest understands the moment.
blocks.label: See Vivah packages

faqs.q: Saat phere kis cheez ke prateek hain?
faqs.a: Each phera is a vachan — nourishment, strength, prosperity, happiness, family, health through all seasons, and lifelong friendship (sakhya).

faqs.q: Are seven pheras legally required?
faqs.a: Under the Hindu Marriage Act, where Saptapadi is part of the couple's customary rites, the marriage is complete on the seventh step. Communities with different customary rites are equally valid under their own parampara.

faqs.q: Pheras kaun pehle leta hai — dulha ya dulhan?
faqs.a: Commonly the bride leads the first three or four pheras and the groom the rest, though traditions differ regionally. Your Pandit Ji follows your family's custom.

posts.title: Kundali Milan for Marriage: 36 Gunas, Ashtakoot Matching & What Score You Need
posts.metaTitle: Kundali Milan | 36 Guna Matching for Marriage Explained (Ashtakoot)
posts.metaDescription: Kundali milan explained in simple words — the 8 koots, how the 36 gunas add up, kitne gun milne chahiye, what nadi dosha and bhakoot dosha mean, and when scores can be overridden.
posts.coverAlt: Puja thali and diya arranged for kundali milan before a vivah
posts.author: Pandit Ji At Request — Vivah Desk
posts.intro: Rishta pakka karne se pehle sabse pehla sawal — kitne gun mile? Here is the Ashtakoot system explained honestly: what the 36 gunas measure, what a good score is, aur kab low score ke bawajood vivah shubh ho sakta hai.

blocks.text: What kundali milan actually measures

Ashtakoot milan compares the two birth charts across eight koots (dimensions), each carrying points that total 36. It is not fortune-telling — it is a compatibility map across temperament, health, prosperity and progeny, as the rishis codified it.
The 8 koots and their points

items: Varna (1) — temperament & work compatibility
Vashya (2) — mutual influence
Tara (3) — birth-star harmony & fortune
Yoni (4) — instinctive/physical compatibility
Graha Maitri (5) — mental & planetary friendship
Gana (6) — nature: deva, manushya, rakshasa
Bhakoot (7) — emotional & financial harmony
Nadi (8) — health & progeny (highest weight)

blocks.text: Kitne gun milne chahiye?

items: 18–24: acceptable — vivah generally approved
25–32: very good match
33–36: excellent (rare)
Below 18: the charts ask for deeper review, not automatic rejection

blocks.text: Important: a low score is a flag, not a verdict. An experienced Pandit Ji reads the WHOLE chart — a nadi or bhakoot dosha can be cancelled by specific planetary positions (dosha-bhanga), aur kai baar 'kam gun' wali jodi ke charts mein stronger yogas hote hain jo score nahi dikhata.
Sirf app ka score mat maaniye. Software counts points; a Vedacharya reads cancellations, dashas and remedies. Dono ka use kariye.
Kundali available nahi hai to?

If birth time is unknown, matching can be done by name-rashi (less precise) or the Pandit Ji can advise a simple remedial path. Our booking flow accepts either full birth details or an uploaded kundali image for both var and vadhu.
Book Kundali Milan by a verified Vedacharya — details or photo upload, both work.
blocks.label: Book Kundali Milan

faqs.q: Kundali milan mein minimum kitne gun chahiye?
faqs.a: 18 of 36 is the conventional threshold. Below 18, a deeper chart review is advised — doshas may be cancelled by specific positions, so rejection should never be automatic.

faqs.q: Nadi dosha kya hota hai?
faqs.a: When both charts share the same nadi (Adi/Madhya/Antya), 8 points are lost and health/progeny concerns are flagged. Several classical cancellations exist — same nakshatra different pada, among others — which a Pandit Ji verifies.

faqs.q: Kya Mangal dosha wale ki shaadi ho sakti hai?
faqs.a: Yes. Mangal dosha is frequently cancelled by counter-positions in either chart, and remedies (Kumbh vivah, specific pujas) exist for genuine cases. Lakhs of manglik marriages thrive.

posts.intro: Ek Hindu vivah is not one event — it is a JOURNEY of rituals, each with a purpose the rishis designed. From the first kundali milan to the tearful vidaai, here is the complete sequence and kyon har rasam hoti hai.

blocks.text: Before the wedding

items: Kundali Milan — charts matched, 36 gunas counted, muhurat window agreed
Roka / Sagai (Tilak) — the families' word is given; rings exchanged
Haldi — turmeric's purification and glow, applied with laughter and song
Mehndi & Sangeet — joy, adornment and the two families becoming one

blocks.text: The wedding day, in order

items: Ganesh–Gauri Puja — every shubh karya begins with Ganpati
Mandap & Kalash Sthapana — the sacred canopy and kalash established
Baraat & Milni — the groom arrives; elders of both sides embrace
Jaimala (Varmala) — garlands exchanged, the first mutual acceptance
Kanyadaan — the highest daan a parent can give
Panigrahana — the groom takes the bride's hand into his keeping
Vivah Homa & Mangal Pheras — rounds of the sacred fire
Saptapadi — seven steps, seven vows; the marriage completes
Sindoor & Mangalsutra — the visible seals of the union
Ashirwad & Vidaai — blessings, and the daughter's farewell

posts.title: Haldi Ceremony: Significance, Vidhi & Why Turmeric Before the Wedding
posts.metaTitle: Haldi Ceremony Significance | Why Haldi Before Wedding, Vidhi & Muhurat
posts.metaDescription: Haldi sirf photos ke liye nahi hai — the real ayurvedic and shastric significance of the haldi ceremony, the correct vidhi, kaun lagata hai haldi, and what the yellow colour means.
posts.coverAlt: Marigold and turmeric tones of a traditional haldi decor
posts.author: Pandit Ji At Request — Vivah Desk
posts.intro: Instagram ne haldi ko yellow-theme party bana diya, but the rasam is far older and deeper. Turmeric is Ayurveda's antiseptic, jyotish ka Guru-graha colour, and the shastra's mark of mangal. Here is the real meaning and the correct vidhi.

blocks.text: Why turmeric, of all things?

items: Ayurveda: haldi purifies the skin, calms nerves and protects against infection before the biggest day
Jyotish: yellow is Brihaspati's (Jupiter's) colour — the graha of marriage and wisdom
Shastra: haldi-chandan ubtan is a shuddhi (purification) rite, preparing body and mind for sanskara

blocks.text: The correct vidhi

Haldi is ground with chandan, milk or rose water into ubtan. Suhagan women (and in many families, everyone with blessings to give) apply it to the face, arms and feet of the dulha/dulhan — five daubs symbolising the panch tatva. The leftover haldi is considered charged with mangal; unmarried friends often take a daub for their own good fortune!
Muhurat matters here too — haldi is done on a shubh day usually 1–3 days before the pheras, morning hours preferred. Pandit Ji fixes it alongside the main lagna.
Same haldi, dono taraf
In many communities the SAME haldi paste travels from the groom's ceremony to the bride's — a beautiful symbol that one blessing now covers two houses.
Add Haldi as a single ritual, or take a package where it's already included with samagri.
blocks.label: Book Haldi ceremony

faqs.q: Haldi kab lagayi jaati hai?
faqs.a: On a shubh muhurat 1–3 days before the wedding, usually in the morning. Your Pandit Ji fixes it with the main lagna.

faqs.q: Haldi ceremony mein kya kya samagri lagti hai?
faqs.a: Haldi, chandan, milk/rose water, a mixing thali, mango leaves, flowers and a diya — our samagri option includes the complete kit.

faqs.q: Kya haldi ke baad bahar jana mana hai?
faqs.a: Tradition advises the bride and groom stay home after haldi until the pheras — the ubtan marks the start of their sanskara period, protected and kept mangal.

posts.title: Mangal Dosha (Manglik) & Marriage: Myths, Cancellations and Real Remedies
posts.metaTitle: Mangal Dosha in Marriage | Manglik Matching, Cancellation & Remedies
posts.metaDescription: Manglik hona shaadi ka full-stop nahi hai. What mangal dosha actually is, the classical cancellations most software misses, Kumbh Vivah truth, and remedies that are shastra-sammat.
posts.coverAlt: Diya flame at dusk — prayer and remedy in Vedic tradition
posts.author: Pandit Ji At Request — Vivah Desk
posts.intro: Shaadi ki baat chalte hi ek shabd sab rok deta hai — 'manglik'. Par sach yeh hai: most mangal dosha cases carry classical cancellations that matching apps never check. Here is the honest picture.

blocks.text: What mangal dosha is

When Mars sits in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house of the birth chart, its aggressive energy is said to touch the marriage houses — that placement is mangal dosha. Estimates suggest a LARGE share of all charts carry it technically, which alone should tell you it cannot be an automatic disqualifier.
Cancellations most software misses

items: Both partners manglik — the doshas neutralise (dosha samya)
Mars in own sign (Aries/Scorpio) or exalted (Capricorn) — dosha greatly weakened
Benefic aspects of Jupiter/Venus on Mars
Age beyond 28 in several traditions — Mars matures
Specific rashi placements (e.g. Mars-Cancer/Leo variations by school)

blocks.text: A Vedacharya checks each one against BOTH charts. Sirf app ka 'manglik: yes' dekhkar rishta mat todiye.
Remedies that are actually shastric

items: Mangal Shanti Puja on a Tuesday, with proper sankalp
Hanuman upasana and Mangal mantra japa (ॐ अं अंगारकाय नमः)
Daan: masoor dal, red cloth, coral as advised
Kumbh Vivah — only for specific severe cases, performed with dignity and privacy

blocks.text: Kumbh Vivah is widely misunderstood and often unnecessarily prescribed. Get a second reading before agreeing to it — many 'severe' cases are cancelled doshas.
Get both kundalis read properly by a verified Vedacharya before any decision.
blocks.label: Book Kundali Milan

faqs.q: Kya manglik ki shaadi non-manglik se ho sakti hai?
faqs.a: Yes, when cancellations exist in either chart or after appropriate shanti remedies — a proper reading of both charts decides, not the label.

faqs.q: Mangal dosha ke lakshan kya hote hain?
faqs.a: There are no outward 'lakshan' — it is purely a chart placement. Life events attributed to it usually have many astrological factors; avoid fear-based conclusions.

faqs.q: Mangal Shanti Puja kab karani chahiye?
faqs.a: On a Tuesday in a shubh muhurat before the wedding, with sankalp in the couple's names. It can be booked alongside your vivah package.

posts.metaDescription: Nayi bahu ka pehla kadam — the complete griha pravesh vidhi after marriage: kalash of rice, alta feet, aarti, muhurat rules and the beautiful meaning behind each step.
posts.coverAlt: Lamps lit at a doorway for a bride's griha pravesh
posts.author: Pandit Ji At Request — Vivah Desk
posts.intro: Vidaai ke aansuon ke baad aata hai sabse sundar swagat — griha pravesh. The bride does not just enter a house; shastra says Lakshmi enters it. Here is the vidhi, step by step.

blocks.text: The rice kalash at the door

A kalash filled with rice (or wheat) is placed at the threshold. The bride gently topples it with her right foot — grain flowing inward — announcing that abundance walks in with her. फिर वह अल्ता लगे पैरों से प्रवेश करती है, leaving red footprints that families treasure.
The sequence

items: Aarti & tilak of the couple at the door — nazar utarna
Kalash toppled with the RIGHT foot, entering right-foot first
Alta footprints across the threshold
Dudh-bhaat / first sweet offered by the saas
Couple's first joint pranam at the ghar-mandir
Mooh dikhai — elders bless and gift the new bahu

blocks.text: Muhurat and timing

Griha pravesh is usually done immediately on arrival from the vidaai, in the same journey's mangal continuity. Where travel splits the days, a Pandit Ji sets a short shubh window — evening pravesh is avoided in most traditions unless the panchang specifically supports it.
Keep the alta and rice ready BEFORE the baraat returns — scrambling at the door is the most common hiccup in the sweetest ritual.
Our packages can extend to the griha pravesh and first-week rituals — ask the Pandit Ji.
blocks.label: Plan the full journey

faqs.q: Griha pravesh kis paer se karna chahiye?
faqs.a: Right foot first — दाहिना पैर — after toppling the rice kalash inward, symbolising abundance entering the home.

faqs.q: Kya griha pravesh raat mein ho sakta hai?
faqs.a: Most traditions avoid late-evening pravesh unless the panchang supports it; your Pandit Ji fixes a short shubh window on arrival day.

faqs.q: Mooh dikhai kya hoti hai?
faqs.a: The affectionate ritual where family elders formally 'see' the new bride, bless her and give shagun gifts — the family's first embrace of its newest member.

posts.title: Court Marriage vs Vedic Vivah: Legal Facts + Why Many Couples Do Both
posts.metaTitle: Court Marriage vs Vedic Vivah | Legal Validity, Cost & Doing Both
posts.metaDescription: Court marriage ya vedic vivah — kya legal hai, kya zaroori hai? The Hindu Marriage Act on saptapadi, registration rules, costs of both, and why many couples now do both together.
posts.coverAlt: A mandap dressed for a complete Vedic vivah ceremony
posts.author: Pandit Ji At Request — Vivah Desk
posts.intro: "Court marriage kar lete hain, simple rahega" — par phir dil kehta hai pheras ke bina shaadi adhoori hai. Good news: the law honours BOTH paths, and they combine beautifully. Here are the facts, बिना confusion के.

blocks.text: What the law actually says

Under the Hindu Marriage Act (Section 7), a marriage solemnised with the couple's customary rites — including Saptapadi where customary — is fully legal the moment the seventh step completes. Court registration under the Act EVIDENCES the marriage; the vivah itself solemnises it. The Special Marriage Act path (court marriage) is an alternative civil route, essential for interfaith couples.
Side by side

items: Legal validity: both fully valid
Time: court route needs 30-day notice; vedic vivah needs only a muhurat
Cost: court ₹500–₹2,000 official fees; vivah as per your package
Sanskara: only the vedic vivah is a sanskara — the 16th of Hindu life
Registration: recommended after BOTH — it is your marriage's documentary proof

blocks.text: Why many couples do both

Pheras for the soul and the family; registration for the passport office. The order doesn't matter legally, par families ko pheras pehle karna hi shubh lagta hai. Registrar ke liye, your Pandit Ji's vivah certificate, photos of the pheras and witnesses' signatures are the standard evidence set.
Hamare packages include a Vedic Vivah certificate — the document registrars ask for alongside photos when you register.
A complete shastra-sammat vivah, certificate included.
blocks.label: See packages

faqs.q: Kya sirf pheras se shaadi legal hai?
faqs.a: Yes — under the Hindu Marriage Act, marriage by customary rites (with Saptapadi where customary) is legally complete. Registration afterwards is strongly recommended as proof.

faqs.q: Court marriage ke liye kitne din lagte hain?
faqs.a: The Special Marriage Act requires a 30-day public notice after filing; the certificate follows the ceremony at the registrar's office.

faqs.q: Vivah ke baad registration kaise hota hai?
faqs.a: Apply at your district registrar with the vivah certificate/pandit's attestation, photos of the ceremony, ID-address proofs and witnesses. Many states now accept online applications.

posts.title: Shubh, Raj ya Maharaja? Choosing the Right Vivah Package for Your Family
posts.hindiTitle: कौन सा विवाह पैकेज सही है?
posts.metaTitle: Which Vivah Package to Choose | Shubh vs Raj vs Maharaja Compared
posts.metaDescription: 1 pandit ya 3? Coordinator chahiye ya nahi? An honest comparison of vivah packages — what each tier actually adds, who each is right for, aur kab single rituals zyada sense banate hain.
posts.coverAlt: A regal thali and kalash — the centrepiece of a premium vivah package
posts.author: Pandit Ji At Request — Vivah Desk
posts.intro: Teen packages, ek decision. Honest answer: bigger is not automatically better — the right tier depends on guest count, venue scale aur aapki family ki tradition-depth. Here is how to actually choose.

blocks.text: What genuinely changes between tiers

items: Pandit count: 1 → 2 → 3. Beyond ~150 guests or parallel rituals (both sides' shagun simultaneously), a second Pandit Ji stops the day running late
Coordinator: the top tier adds one person who owns the run-sheet — worth it when venue, caterer and families all need syncing
Gifts/uphaar: shagun sets for dulha-dulhan and elite ritual kits scale up
Temple darshan: one free live darshan → all listed temples for the couple

blocks.text: Who should pick what

items: Shubh — intimate weddings (under ~100 guests), one venue, straightforward vidhi. Everything sacred, nothing extra
Raj — the sweet spot: 100–300 guests, grander vidhi with Mukhya Acharya + Sahayak, shagun gifts included
Maharaja — large or multi-day weddings, parallel ceremonies, families who want the concierge to carry EVERYTHING

blocks.text: When single rituals make more sense

Agar aapke family pandit ji pheras karaenge but you need specialists for kundali milan ya haldi — book just those. Har ritual individually bookable hai with its own transparent price. Mix karna bilkul theek hai.
Whichever tier you pick, the Kashi Acharya seva stacks on top identically — it is an add-on, not a package.
Compare all three side by side, with every included ritual listed.
blocks.label: Compare packages

faqs.q: 2 pandit ji kab zaroori hote hain?
faqs.a: Beyond roughly 150 guests, or when rituals run in parallel (both families' rasmein simultaneously) — a Mukhya Acharya + Sahayak keeps the muhurat on time.

faqs.q: Kya package ke saath samagri included hai?
faqs.a: Package tiers include complete samagri. Single rituals let you toggle samagri on (added transparently) or off (bring your own, zero charge).

faqs.q: Kya packages customise ho sakte hain?
faqs.a: Yes — special requests (family customs, sankalp names, gotra) are captured at checkout, and the callback option lets our team tailor anything unusual.
